# ref(health) Consulting

> Executive healthcare data leadership, Data AI Operating Systems (HDAIOS), and strategic advisory for health-tech founders and digital health organizations.

ref(health) Consulting connects 21 years of healthcare operating experience across payer, provider, wellness, and care navigation with senior executive data leadership, Data AI Operating System architecture, and multi-model AI orchestration. The practice serves health-tech founders, CEOs, and CTOs as a Fractional VP of Data and delivers focused 2-week AI-readiness diagnostics starting at $2,500.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Fractional Healthcare Data Leadership & Strategy](https://refhealth.consulting/healthcare-data-strategy.html#fractional-leadership): Senior data executive leadership for health-tech founders: board reporting, metric architecture, team hiring, cloud BAA boundaries, and AI strategy.
- [Company Data AI Operating System](https://refhealth.consulting/healthcare-ai-consulting.html): Architectural framework connecting business decisions, governed data products, model strategy, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://refhealth.consulting/ai-readiness-assessment.html): 2-week paid diagnostic starting at $2,500 evaluating data foundation, pipeline fitness, and model readiness before funding major builds.
- [Healthcare Data Strategy](https://refhealth.consulting/healthcare-data-strategy.html): Data landscape analysis, source system mapping, ownership, and governance across clinical and claims data.
- [dbt Analytics Engineering & Claims Lag Calculator](https://refhealth.consulting/dbt-consulting.html): Governed data foundations (Layer 2 of HDAIOS), tested dimensional data models, and interactive client-side Claims Lag & Capital Float Calculator (`#calculator`) for healthcare teams.
- [Diagnostic Intake](https://refhealth.consulting/intake.html): Scoping portal for the 2-week $2,500 diagnostic evaluation.
- [About the Practice](https://refhealth.consulting/about.html): Senior executive background across healthcare operations, data leadership, analytics, and AI delivery.

## Key Frameworks & Technical Insights

- [Healthcare Data AI Operating System (HDAIOS) Specification v1.0 & Self-Assessment Tool](https://refhealth.consulting/hdaios.html): Formal 5-layer architectural specification and interactive, zero-PHI self-assessment audit tool (Raw Markdown: [hdaios.md](https://refhealth.consulting/hdaios.md)).
- [EDI 837 vs 835 Claims Modeling in dbt: Reconciliation, Reversals, and Denial Rates Without Row Multiplication](https://refhealth.consulting/blog-edi-837-835-claims-modeling-dbt.html): Dissecting claim submission vs remittance advice matching, claim frequency codes, CAS adjustment segment normalization, takeback/reversal handling, and true net denial rates.
- [The 48-Hour Healthcare dbt Audit Playbook](https://refhealth.consulting/blog-healthcare-dbt-audit-playbook.html): A senior analytics engineer's playbook for triaging claims lag, bitemporal eligibility desync, midnight timestamp precision drops, and code drift using production dbt tests.
- [Bitemporal Healthcare Data, dbt Testing Standards, and the LLM Trap](https://refhealth.consulting/blog-bitemporal-healthcare-data-ai.html): Why claims lag breaks naive AI agents, the operational truth behind every timestamp, non-negotiable dbt tests, and Schmitt-Thompson clinical triage boundaries.
- [What Is a Data AI Operating System for Healthcare?](https://refhealth.consulting/blog-data-ai-operating-system.html): The five-layer architecture: business decisions, data products, model strategy, workflow layer, operating cadence.
- [Single-Provider vs Multi-Model Healthcare AI Strategy](https://refhealth.consulting/blog-healthcare-ai-model-strategy.html): Architectural criteria for orchestrating models across labs vs going deep inside one provider.
- [Why We Build Healthcare Data Stacks with dbt](https://refhealth.consulting/blog-why-we-build-with-dbt.html): Test coverage, data lineage, documentation, and metric contracts for healthcare compliance.
- [The $100k-per-Day Healthcare Data Mistake](https://refhealth.consulting/blog-100k-per-day-mistake.html): Why domain knowledge and operational context matter more than raw compute in healthcare analytics.

## Open-Source Healthcare Data Tools & Standards

- [refhealth-dbt-healthcare-checks](https://github.com/apratsunrthd/refhealth-dbt-healthcare-checks): Standardized generic dbt tests enforcing bitemporal enrollment consistency, CMS NPI formatting, ICD-10/CPT validity, midnight timestamp audits, and referential integrity.
- [refhealth-starter-dbt-project](https://github.com/apratsunrthd/refhealth-starter-dbt-project): Production-ready healthcare dbt starter project (v1.2.0) with synthetic claims, bitemporal eligibility, monthly actuarial metrics (MLR, PMPM, claims lag percentiles), clinical FHIR encounter crosswalk, DuckDB zero-setup execution, and 106 pre-configured healthcare data tests.
- [refhealth-feed-triage](https://github.com/apratsunrthd/refhealth-feed-triage): Local Model Context Protocol (MCP) extension for Claude Desktop inspecting CSV event feeds and FHIR Bundles without transmitting PHI.
